entries.title: Contents
entries.html:
This workbook contains estimates for the GHG emissions associated with the supply of livestock products to several meat and dairy companies. The estimates are based on reported or estimated animal processing data for each company, and estimates of average emissions for livestock products from the FAO's GLEAM 2.0 tool.
TABLE OF CONTENTS
Tab 1Results overviewSummary table of results for all milk and meat companies assessed
Tab 2Results, meat Emissions estimates for five major meat processing companies
Tab 3Results, milk Emissions estimates for ten major dairy companies
Tab 4Production dataAssumptions for meat and milk processed by each company, with sources
Tab 5Company dataAdditional background company production data
Tab 6GLEAM emissions tablesEmission factors for meat and milk production from GLEAM, expressed in terms of GWP100 using values from both IPCC AR5 and AR6, and in terms of GWP20 using values from IPCC AR6
Tab 7Supplementary dataAdditional assumptions used in the estimations, including typical animal slaughter weights and dressing precentages and the GWP values used
Tab 8GLEAM regionsCountries in each of the regions used in GLEAM 2.0
Tab 9 Methane comparisonsComparisons of company methane emissions, underlying data for figures 2 to 4 in the report
Tab 10Comparison GWP 100 & 20Comparisons of emissions based on GWP100 vs. GWP20, underlying data for figures 5 & 6 in the report
Tab 11Total GHG comparisonsComparisons of company total GHG emissions, underlying data for figures 7 & 8 in the report
